name: Independence Arch
features: Concrete triumphal arch crowned by the Black Star, closing the vast parade ground of Black Star Square.
note: Wikipedia infobox names the Ghana Public Works Department as designer, no individual architect. Category has 20+ free photos; File:Independence Arch, Accra.jpg shows the arched grandstand on the square, not the arch itself.

name: Job 600
features: Long slab built in months for the 1965 OAU summit, its gridded facade split by tall vertical bands.
note: Only one clear photo of the slab (4032x3024); the other file in the category is a distant view down the forecourt. Architect: Wikipedia names none; other sources searched did not confirm one, so 'by' is left empty. Renovated 2015 by China State Hualong; facade description is from the photo, check before using.

name: National Museum of Ghana
features: Low concrete museum under a saucer-shaped aluminium dome, with windows angled like teeth to dodge the sun.

photos.file: File:Main entrance of National Museum of Ghana.jpg

note: Opened 5 March 1957, the eve of independence. National Museum of Ghana.jpg shows the dome behind the entrance wing; the entrance photos are partly hidden by trees.

name: Hôtel Ivoire
by: Heinz Fenchel, Thomas Leitersdorf, William Pereira
features: Lagoon-side hotel town: a 1963 block, a 24-storey tower, casino, rink and pools laid out as one resort.
note: Main building 1963 (17 storeys), tower 1969 (24 storeys, 100 m), more rooms 1972; renovated 2015. Several other category photos show only the pools and grounds.

name: Hilton Nairobi
features: Cylindrical tower of even window bands on a low podium, a post-independence break with colonial hotels.
note: No English Wikipedia article. Opened 1969 by Jomo Kenyatta; hotel closed 2022/23. No source found names the architect, so 'by' is empty.

name: Findeco House
features: Zambia's tallest tower: 23 storeys of deep concrete sun-shading, by Yugoslav architects for Kaunda's state.
note: Dates disagree (Wikipedia 1978-79; others 1971-78); 1978 is the widely reported opening by Kaunda. Best photo (3786x2853) shows the tower in full beside a park; File:Lusaka, Zambia CBD Kafue Roundabout.jpg is an aerial where it is small. 'Brise-soleil' is read from the photo, not stated in sources.

name: Cocoa House
features: West Africa's first skyscraper, 26 storeys, built with cocoa-farming revenue as a symbol of the Western Region.

photos.file: File:Cocoa House, Liebu bye pass, Ibadan.jpg

note: Completed 1964, commissioned July 1965; 26 storeys, 105 m. Attribution is unsettled: a 1960 trade journal lists The Plan Group (West Africa); other research links Nickson & Borys. Built by Cappa & D'Alberto. ~19 free photos in the category.

name: Independence House
features: 25-storey reinforced-concrete office slab beside Tafawa Balewa Square, a year after independence.
note: Only one usable photo, 1080x1440 (passes the 800px rule), looking up at the tower over a lower building. Wikipedia: 25 floors, 103 m, designed and built by G. Cappa.
